notes.title: Day and night cycle (first images)
notes.notes:
« Work, work, work, work, work, work»
-	Rihanna


Time moves relentlessly in Cheesemount, where you will toil for the cheese-hunting empire of TERESAL.  An hour, in this rat worId, flows faster than a human might expect. Efficiency is crucial. If you don’t perform good enough, the supervisors might snitch you to the bosses and you will feel the wrath of their consequences. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41384730/396861a3ea957431c36bc1242193a45b83ac8e75.gif[/img]

BE THERE ON TIME OR SPEND THE NIGHT OUTSIDE
Every night at the same hour, the gate to Cheesemount closes. If you didn’t get back in time, tough luck. You will have to spend the night outside (and outside isn’t pretty when the sun comes down). 

[previewyoutube=KZS8MbzNwgk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Discord Launch ! AMA with devs to celebrate.
notes.notes:
We are stoked to announce the launch of our new Discord ! This sewer... err... I meant "server"... will be a perfect way for you to connect with us and other players, share rat experiences, and get help with any questions or issues you may have. It will also be the place to give us suggestions as we develop the game. 

To celebrate the launch of the Discord, one of us will personally be answering each players' questions for the next two weeks. 

Click [url=https://discord.gg/8S2FctpKe3]here[/url] and help us make a cozy junkyard out of this mess.

xox

notes.title: A Rat's Life demo OUT NOW !
notes.notes:
The demo for[b] Pieces Games[/b]’ debut project  [b][i]A Rat’s Life : The Cat Conspiracy[/i][/b], a first-person rat adventure, is now live on Steam. 

It features exclusive achievements and around 1:30 to 3 hours of playtime.

We're only two persons working on this project, and players' comments help us a lot. Feel free to complete this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0SL8rJO2vxdlZLLpMz1eoZ9Pc-Cyi7Sf7xjxCvYotlE36ww/viewform]survey[/url] after your playthrough. 

[previewyoutube=rtDSIRuMfBs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What to expect: [/b]
[list]
[*] First-person rat action : run on four paws, travel through pipes, talk to your neighbors, climb walls, MOVE LIKE A RAT ;
[*] Detect odors and dig through walls to gather yum, dirt and maybe even cheese (or just destroy the walls because you're a vermin and destroying walls is what you do) ; 
[*] Buy props and equip your rat to access new areas ;
[*] Sneak around the Third Wall Cheese District, a borough populated by friends and shady characters.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41384730/70622b283366efd96d6462a0d3ca009b1b9ca818.gif[/img]
